intro.zh-CN: 以下 MCP tools 提供代码语义查询，无需读取完整源文件：
intro.en: MCP tools provide semantic code queries without reading full source files:

purpose.zh-CN: 查找函数/类的文件位置、签名、层
获取函数/类的 docstring 摘要，无需 Read 源文件
purpose.en: Get function/class docstring summary without Read

purpose.zh-CN: 获取文件级语义摘要：角色、关键符号、层级
purpose.en: Get file-level semantic summary: role, key symbols, layer

purpose.zh-CN: 修改该文件会波及哪些模块
purpose.en: Which modules are affected by changes

purpose.zh-CN: 按名称模糊搜索符号（前缀/子串/编辑距离）
查找多个符号间的调用路径（双向 BFS）
purpose.en: Find call paths among symbols (bidirectional BFS)

purpose.zh-CN: 子系统级语义概览：入口、契约、依赖
列出指定 cluster 的成员文件，可选附短摘要
purpose.en: List a cluster's member files, optionally with short summaries

purpose.zh-CN: 用自然语言意图定位相关 cluster/file/symbol
purpose.en: Locate relevant cluster/file/symbol by natural-language intent

zh-CN: 了解项目结构或模块职责时 → query_symbol + query_symbol_summary + query_file_summary（替代 Read 全文件）
评估修改影响时 → query_impact（替代手动 Grep 搜索）
追踪调用链时 → query_callers / query_callees（替代逐文件阅读）
⚠ 当目标仅是理解函数签名或用途时，应优先调用 query_symbol_summary，而非 Read 整个源文件
⚠ 当目标是了解整个文件的角色时，应优先调用 query_file_summary，而非 Read 整个源文件
⚠ 当目标是确认调用关系时，应优先调用 query_callers/query_callees，而非逐文件 Grep
⚠ 当目标是了解 cluster 内文件分布时，应优先调用 query_cluster_files，而非手动 grep cluster 目录
en: Understanding project/module structure → query_symbol + query_symbol_summary + query_file_summary (instead of Read)
Assessing change impact → query_impact (instead of manual Grep)
Tracing call chains → query_callers / query_callees (instead of file-by-file reading)
⚠ When your goal is to understand a function's signature or purpose, prefer query_symbol_summary over reading the full source file
⚠ When your goal is to understand a file's overall role, prefer query_file_summary over reading the full source file
⚠ When your goal is to confirm call relationships, prefer query_callers/query_callees over file-by-file grep
⚠ When your goal is to understand file distribution within a cluster, prefer query_cluster_files over manual grep
